name: ballast
description: Builds up to a goal in a field you have no expertise in: splits it into the foundations that goal actually needs, mobilizes what you already hold, learns what is missing, and leaves every solved path behind for the next goal. Nothing is called done until a check passes.

interface.shortDescription: Build unfamiliar goals into verified, reusable paths.
interface.longDescription: Turn unfamiliar goals into verified work while retaining rules, decisions, and solved procedures for reuse.
defaultPrompt: Help me turn this unfamiliar goal into a verified, reusable plan.
